0022600005.text: Both the Golden State Warriors and the Los Angeles Lakers open their 2026-27 seasons with this regular-season game, with the Warriors on the road. Golden State is missing Brandin Podziemski (back, soreness), Charles Bassey (knee), Jimmy Butler III (knee, surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), and Moses Moody (knee, surgery), while Stephen Curry (ankle sprain) is day-to-day and a game-time decision, and Los Angeles is without Adou Thiero (knee) and Cameron Carr (oblique strain), with Collin Sexton (calf) also day-to-day and a game-time decision. In 2025-26 the Warriors lost the season series 1-3, and their most recent meeting was a 119-103 loss in San Francisco on April 9, 2026.
